title: Montreal’s transit agency says too expensive to display ‘Go Habs Go!’ before winter
summary: MONTREAL — Montreal’s transit agency says city buses won’t be flashing the “Go! Canadiens Go!” NHL hockey slogan any time soon, despite getting the green light to do so by Quebec’s language watchdog. title: Calgary man who ran large-scale Ponzi scheme ordered to pay millions in penalties
summary: CALGARY — A Calgary man has been sanctioned by the Alberta Securities Commission following a securities fraud investigation that found the man had bilked investors of millions of dollars in one of the largest Ponzi schemes the province has seen.
